mapper.sql: d.id, d.workplace_id, d.parent_id, w.workplace_name, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.sort_order, d.status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM department d LEFT JOIN workplace w ON w.id = d.workplace_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC, d.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET workplace_id = #{in.workplaceId}, parent_id = #{in.parentId}, department_code = #{in.departmentCode}, department_name = #{in.departmentName}, sort_order = #{in.sortOrder}, status = #{in.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
